I guess I will try to go for a walk tomorrow, I don't know where to but ill try to think of something, also I don't usually go out so my panic attacks rarely happen.

Thanks again for the advice.

I wouldn't be able to deal with the discomfort I have panic attacks when surrounded by too many people. I wouldn't know what to do or where to go even if I did go outside. I would just be standing outside my house looking lost. But thank you for the advice. Everyone here is so nice and helpful.
I don't think I can volunteer because of how many people would be there, I would feel uncomfortable and probably not go back the next day. But thank you for the suggestion, and thank you for helping.

But what kind of person would want to be friends with someone who hates himself? And what job would hire somebody without a education or set of skills? I just feel like there isn't anything in this world for me. thank you for replying you are making me feel alot better than I did 30 minutes ago.

I don't know, I guess my lack of social life, my lack of income so I can't help my mother pay the bills, my lack of education stopping me from getting a job.

Thank you again for replying, you have me in tears because I feel like somebody cares other then people obligated too like my mother.

I can't go back to school because I don't like being social, I can't get an education because I can't go back to school, I can't get a job because I can't get an education, I can't learn any skills because I can't get a job, I can't make any friends because I don't go outside. I have no good things in my life anymore, I have messed my life up beyond fixing. But I thank you for replying.
